title: Auth email, env safety, and style-standardization handoff
content:
Auth notification email delivery was traced end-to-end after the live restart. The main issue was runtime env confusion rather than a broken notification system: live secrets belong in the untracked server .env, while tracked reference env files stay sanitized.

  • SMTP verification and a direct diagnostic send succeeded, and the message arrived after a short provider delay.
  • The live Auth server should start from E:\auth-jeffersonwm\backend, not the UNC share path, so Node/tsx resolves the app correctly.
  • Perihelion multi-element exports are already using the intended model: one notification event with an Elements JSON link instead of one event per exported item.
  • Next direction: start with Auth, align its title/tabs/section-block structure to Perihelion, then turn that into a reusable Peri demo/reference for the rest of the sites.
